name: @zippy-go/api-contract
description: ZippyGo API contract: OpenAPI document, event schemas, generated SDKs and the developer portal

scripts.lint: pnpm lint:redocly && pnpm bundle && pnpm lint:spectral
scripts.bundle: redocly bundle openapi/openapi.yaml --output dist/openapi.json && redocly bundle openapi/openapi.yaml --output dist/openapi.yaml
scripts.portal:dev: pnpm bundle && pnpm portal:sync && vitepress dev portal
scripts.portal:build: pnpm bundle && pnpm portal:sync && vitepress build portal
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm gen:ts && pnpm typecheck && pnpm events:check && pnpm portal:build
